composition.browser: Existing Chromium153 binary; CDP pipes; no TCP listener; ordinary user sandbox; no --no-sandbox
composition.temporary: New /tmp/rf-* private directory for profile/TMPDIR; --disable-dev-shm-usage routes Chromium shared-memory files to this private temporary allocation rather than the refused UID shared-memory namespace.
composition.source: Exact unchanged canonical demo.html and authored course; local-file import; no server or package install.
composition.output: Two selected viewport PNGs, two real text downloads, small JSON/source maps; stderr retention stops after approximately256KiB plus the last incoming chunk.
composition.cleanup: Browser.close then SIGTERM/SIGKILL restricted to the spawned detached browser process group; profile remains private; no peer/shared cleanup.

limits: These are admission reserves, not enforced upper bounds on Chromium profile, temporary file or process memory usage.
A120-second browser lifetime does not impose a hard disk quota.
No browser has launched; no claim of browser isolation, rendered correctness or complete network silence is available.
Future execution needs fresh positive native capacity and a receiving owner to accept the complete resource composition; do not lower the frozen thresholds.
current_disposition: Held before launch; static resource review only, no capacity poll or product replay.
